intent: Cross the valley floor, ascend grassy and rocky slopes, reach the upper meadow and descend a long sunlit hillside.

sections.name: The valley floor
sections.lesson: Low jumps lead to the rising hillside

signs.text:
The valley floor
Low jumps lead to the rising hillside

sections.name: The grassy incline
sections.lesson: Aim diagonally up the stepping hillside

signs.text:
The grassy incline
Aim diagonally up the stepping hillside

sections.name: The rocky sun slope
sections.lesson: Larger diagonal gaps climb the exposed rock

signs.text:
The rocky sun slope
Larger diagonal gaps climb the exposed rock

sections.name: The bright upper meadow
sections.lesson: Catch your rhythm on the broad upper meadow

signs.text:
The bright upper meadow
Catch your rhythm on the broad upper meadow

sections.name: The long downhill
sections.lesson: Carry each landing into the next descending terrace

signs.text:
The long downhill
Carry each landing into the next descending terrace
